newsitem.title: USA: Conn. to sell $162 mln GO bonds week of Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: Conn. to sell $162 mln GO bonds week of Nov 11.

text.p: THE STATE OF CONNECTICUT ANTICIPATES ISSUING APPROXIMATELY $162 MILLION OF GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS DURING THE WEEK OF NOVEMBER 11, 1996.
THE STATE OF CONNECTICUT WILL CONDUCT AN INFORMATIONAL CONFERENCE CALL ON THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 7, 1996 AT 2:00PM TO DISCUSS ITS UPCOMING ISSUE AND ANSWER INVESTOR QUESTIONS.

YOU ARE INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN THE INVESTOR CONFERENCE CALL BY CALLING 1-800-403-1030 PRIOR TO 1:50PM ON THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 7, 1996 SO THAT THE CALL CAN START PROMPTLY AT 2:00PM. THE PARTICIPANT CODE IS 804801.
YOU WILL BE CONNECTED TO THE CALL FOR A BRIEF PRESENTATION BY THE STATE OFFICIALS, FOLLOWED BY A QUESTION AND ANSWER PERIOD.
W.H. Newbold's Son & Co. (A Division of Fahnestock & Co., Inc.)
